json.how_to_verify: digest = sha256(canonical body: v, kind, subject{chainId,at,ref}, model, answers[id,question,options,value,probabilities,confidence], and for decision.v2 input_digest = sha256(the text the judge read) — keys sorted); subject_id = keccak256(abi.encode("taifoon.decision.subject.v1", chainId, at, bytes32(ref))); kind_id = keccak256(kind); then JevDecisionLog.decisionsOf(subject_id)[anchor.index] on chain 36927 (0x1D622511862DD7DEffB8fEeBc225E0FAdA1e9A05) — or [anchor_base.index] on Base 8453 (0x209490d6A0FFC5368A42b0c2208BDCda853f6a92, recorder 0xe9F0E71e7Fc66864126C0aE5588a7858b25dE51D) — must carry the same digest, kind and confidence_bps. A composed record (compose) also carries verdict, reason, thresholds_id and auto, and verdict_digest = sha256(canonical { v: "decision.verdict.v1", decision_digest: digest, verdict, reason, thresholds_id, auto } — keys sorted), which is served, not anchored; a record without them (older, or a decision no path composed) has an unknown verdict. A record is an attestation by the recorder, never a proof.
